name: Totsugeki☆Love Heart
source:
February of the last school year is supposed to be the climax of school life. With just a month left until graduation everything seems the same, but the end mercilessly approaches. Nothing will be the same soon. Is there still time for Spring in protagonist's life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
最后一个学年的二月应该是学校生活的高潮。距离毕业只剩下一个月了，一切似乎都一如往常，但结局却无情地临近。很快一切都不会一样了。主人公的生活里还有春天吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
